The Breaking Point:
Alienation
Multiplied Productive Forces
(World Wealth)
CHIE
Enslavement to the
Division of Labor
The social power generated by the division of labor appears to individuals not as their
own united power, but as an alien force existing outside them, governing them.
The Contradiction: The individual is sacrificed to a narrow, forced sphere of activity (a
hunter, a fisherman, a critical critic) to survive. Meanwhile, the multiplied productive
forces create an existing world of massive wealth and culture. Man's own deed becomes
an alien power opposed to him.

The Necessary Premises for Revolution
Communism cannot exist as a local event or a moral postulate.
It requires two absolute practical premises to abolish alienation:
1. The Intolerable Power: It must render the great mass of
humanity "propertyless" and utterly precarious, cut off from
capital, standing in stark contradiction to a world of wealth.
2. World-Historical Productive Forces: Without the
universal development of productive forces, want is
merely made general, and the "old filthy business" of the
struggle for necessities would be reproduced.
